    Information

    [edit]

    Format

    [edit]
    • Group Stage: November 11th - November 13th
      • Round Robin with 4 groups
      • All matches are Ft2
      • Top 2 teams from each group advances to Playoffs
    • Playoffs: November 14th - November 21st
      • Double elimination bracket
      • All matches (excl. Grand Finals) are Ft3
      • Grand Finals are Ft4
